Settings-only controls."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Liquid Glass — DSH Apple Liquid Glass"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"An Apple-style liquid-glass material for the DeepSeek Harness web client: composer, sidebar controls"},{"id":"p3s2","text":", model picker, and send button, with a faint flowing blue glow along the composer's top edge and si"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"des that freezes while you type. The opening is a rotating blue-particle Earth with blank oceans and"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" flowing land particles; it reads the visitor IP, spins 4 seconds, then blinks a red spot at that lo"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"cation for 3 seconds, with a glass skip button. The page background stays untouched."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Captured in a real DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 web profile."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Repository: <https://github.com/tianyuec11-design/dsh-apple-liquid-glass>"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### From GitHub (recommended)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**DSH Desktop**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin / +** and choose **Install a third-party p"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"lugin**.
3. Paste the repository URL:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"4. Install, then **Enable** it. Refresh the page (or restart if the host asks).
5. Open **Settings**"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" (bottom-left account menu → Settings) → **Liquid Glass**. The intensity slider and the **Opening an"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"imation** switch live there."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**`dsh web`**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` afterwards. `dsh plugin` needs pnpm on `PATH`; the Desktop app ships its own packa"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"h web` afterwards. `dsh plugin` needs pnpm on `PATH`; the Desktop app ships its own package manager."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**GitHub Release tarball**"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"A pinned release is also available as:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Pure CSS material, a tiny DOM controller, a React settings section, and a 2D canvas particle layer"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"; none of them needs a third-party runtime dependency.
- The composer's `backdrop-filter` lives on a"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" `::before` pseudo-element so the card never becomes the backdrop root of its fixed-position popups;"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" `isolation: isolate` keeps the stacking local.
- The blue edge glow lives on the card's `::after`: "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"two side gradients plus a top gradient animated through `background-position`. While typing, the con"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"troller sets `data-dslg-typing="true"` on the card and CSS pauses the animation.
- Sidebar styling t"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"argets clickable elements, never the whole column, so the background stays native.
- Pointer movemen"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"t updates `--dslg-mx/--dslg-my` for a moving specular highlight. Press feedback uses the individual "},{"id":"p19s9","text":"`scale` property so the host's own `transform` survives.
- At 0% the controller removes `body[data-d"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"slg-glass="on"]` and every `--dslg-*` variable; all surface selectors stop matching.
- The Settings "},{"id":"p19s11","text":"section registers through DSH's `settings.section` slot (`slots` + `locale`); no button is added to "},{"id":"p19s12","text":"the chat surface.
- Surface scope is stored as `surfaces` (composer / sidebar / model / send). The c"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"ontroller writes `body[data-dslg-composer|sidebar|model|send="on|off"]`, and every material selector"},{"id":"p19s14","text":" is narrowed by its surface attribute, so turning one off removes only that group of overrides.
- Th"},{"id":"p19s15","text":"e opening is now a full-screen canvas particle Earth: low-resolution continent polygons, Fibonacci s"},{"id":"p19s16","text":"phere sampling, orthographic projection with vertical-axis rotation/tilt, additive rim and land part"},{"id":"p19s17","text":"icles, and a flowing deep-blue-to-light-blue colour phase. The ocean is never filled; an animation s"},{"id":"p19s18","text":"tate machine drives the 4-second 1–2-turn spin and the 3-second red pulse at the IP projection.
- Th"},{"id":"p19s19","text":"e model-switch orb is a 96px 2D canvas: Fibonacci sphere + two flowing ribbons, theme-aware blue/cya"},{"id":"p19s20","text":"n sprites, and a `source-atop` gradient tint. It is positioned just above the model trigger, pointer"},{"id":"p19s21","text":"-transparent, and removed after 5s of flow + 5s of fade.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- DSH **>= 0.2.1-0**.
- Verified on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5** (web profile): light/dark, 0%/62%/100%, glow "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"pause while typing, all four surface switches and their persistence across reload, settings slider a"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"nd splash switch, stroke-order writing and skip, and the particle sphere's transparent occlusion / p"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ointer pass-through / 5+5s timing / auto-removal.
- The model-switch trigger path was verified again"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"st the real model trigger: changing its accessible name/text starts the sphere. The dev profile had "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"no selectable models, so a real menu-item click was not available; the watcher uses the same post-sw"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"itch label change in a normal host.
- Desktop uses the same web client; the settings section relies "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"on the host's `settings.section` / `slots` / `locale` services, available in 0.2.1.
- Chromium/Elect"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"ron only; Safari/Firefox are not tested."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Known limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- The model dropdown menu, message bubbles, and header are not themed yet.
- Small sidebar icon butt"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ons get the material on hover/focus only, to avoid a wall of blur.
- No SVG edge refraction yet; the"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" current material is blur + saturation + translucent tint + specular highlight + bevel + shadow.
- T"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"he opening animation is an approximation of Apple's event style, not Apple's proprietary artwork; it"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" uses bundled Dancing Script with Snell Roundhand / Apple Chancery as system fallbacks.
- The stroke"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" reveal uses one centreline mask path plus a wide soft stroke, not per-glyph vector strokes; the fon"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"t and blue/white gradient are unchanged.
- The model-switch particle orb is a stylised particle appr"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"oximation of the reference image, not the image asset itself. It is about 96px and sits above the mo"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"del trigger instead of centring on the viewport.
- The sphere only appears when the model label chan"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"ges after a recent model-selector interaction; initial hydration and same-model selection do not fir"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"e it. There is no separate switch; reduced-motion shortens it.
- The splash plays once per window se"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"ssion; a same-tab refresh does not repeat it. Toggle it off and on in Settings to preview again.
- T"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"he glow resumes about 1.1s after the last keystroke by design.
- No wallpaper and no page-background"},{"id":"p23s14","text":"esumes about 1.1s after the last keystroke by design.
- No wallpaper and no page-background changes."}],"truncated":true}
